package local.remoteandroid.direct;
import android.os.Looper;
final class MainActivity {
    final InputQueue input;
    android.view.SurfaceView screen=new android.view.SurfaceView();
    int generation=3;
    boolean running=true,dead;
    MainActivity(InputQueue queue) { input=queue; }
    boolean isFinishing() { return dead; }
    boolean isDestroyed() { return dead; }
}
final class UdpVideoProbe { }
public final class AuthenticatedLanUdpUi {
    final MainActivity activity;
    final Object lock=new Object();
    long generation=7;
    Attempt current,retiring;
    static final class Attempt {
        long generation=7;
        boolean cancelled,stopped;
        UdpVideoProbe receiver=new UdpVideoProbe();
        OwnerInputObservation ownerInputObservation;
    }
    AuthenticatedLanUdpUi(InputQueue queue) { activity=new MainActivity(queue); current=new Attempt(); }
/* ACTUAL_APP_ADAPTER */
}
